slides.texte_overlay:
Travel rules every
classy man follows

1. Help with the overhead bin

Especially for older people.
Ten seconds.

2. Leave the hotel room tidy

Towels in one pile.
Someone has to clean it.

3. Learn three words
of the local language

Hello. Thank you. Sorry.
slides.texte_sophia:
3. Learn three words
of the local language

I learn them on the Sophia app
before every trip.

slides.texte_overlay:
4. Keep your voice down
on trains and planes

Nobody wants your call.

5. Respect the local rules

Shoes off, dress codes,
quiet hours. You're a guest.
